Overview

This feature service provides active transportation facility type information for the district of Peachland. It supports review of active transportation network records and related planning or mapping workflows.

Feature Layers

  • Active Transportation - Facility Type: A feature layer describing active transportation facility records with attributes for facility type, priority, and name, supporting identification and organization of transportation assets.

Geographic Coverage

The service covers the district of Peachland in British Columbia.

Use Cases

  • Active transportation planning and inventory management
  • Municipal transportation mapping and reference
  • Review of facility categories and priorities

Source and Access

Owned by district of Peachland  prepared by Urban Systems and distributed under the Regional District of Central Okanagan open data license and terms of use.
